field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: All three mandated headline GGUF definitions.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Coverage and readiness recomputed from rows.
field_principles.candidate_commitment_manifest: Candidate bytes and hashes fixed before model access.
field_principles.family_separation_receipts: Native dimensions and separate family cells.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Required for blocked_precondition or blocked_* verdicts.
field_principles.held_isolation_receipt: No held use during transform design.
field_principles.honest_verdict: States stream completeness without claiming representation quality.
field_principles.inference_substrate: `live_local_sota_gguf_fixed_sequence_representation` declares fixed-sequence local GGUF representation extraction.
field_principles.model_execution_receipts: Authenticated model, device, load, and forward-pass receipts.
field_principles.no_generation_receipts: Call-guard proof that no generation path ran.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Unit, candidate, family, seed, and split rows.
field_principles.phase_concurrency_receipts: Task-local resource and monotonic phase receipts.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: GPU, cache, tokenizer, disk, contract, and commitment checks.
field_principles.raw_vector_manifest: Once-only raw vector paths and hashes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash over models, candidates, raw rows, and code.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False for the model representation; exact labels remain authority.
